functions.port_priority_assign_item_order:
tag @e[tag=ItemOrder,sort=random,limit=1] add temp
execute if entity @e[tag=temp,tag=1_1] run scoreboard players operation @s Item1 = item1 variables

functions.player_circle:
# Function prerequisites:
# 1. radius variables is set to the desired radius of the player circle
# 2. All players getting place in the circle are online and have a minigameplayer score of at least 1 with no duplicates. The scores should be one big straight
# 3. This function is getting executed at the position of the center of the circle
# 4. The players will get teleported(At Yaw=0 by default unless a rotation offset paramter is specified) and will get teleported in order of their minigameplayer score. The exception to this is in a 2v2 minigame where minigameplayer 2 and 3 are switched

kill @e[tag=rotationOffset]
execute unless entity @e[tag=center] store result score playersInCircle variables if entity @a[scores={minigameplayer=1..}]
execute unless entity @e[tag=center] run summon minecraft:marker ^ ^ ^1 {Tags:["rotationOffset"]}
execute unless entity @e[tag=center] run summon minecraft:marker ~ ~ ~ {Tags:["center"]}
execute as @e[tag=center,limit=1] at @s facing entity @e[tag=rotationOffset,limit=1] feet run tp @s ~ ~ ~ ~ ~
kill @e[tag=rotationOffset]
execute unless score gametype variables matches 2 run scoreboard players add minigameplayer variables 1
execute if score gametype variables matches 2 if score minigameplayer variables matches 4.. run scoreboard players add minigameplayer variables 1
execute if score gametype variables matches 2 if score minigameplayer variables matches 2 run scoreboard players set minigameplayer variables 4
execute if score gametype variables matches 2 if score minigameplayer variables matches 3 run scoreboard players set minigameplayer variables 2
execute if score gametype variables matches 2 if score minigameplayer variables matches 1 run scoreboard players set minigameplayer variables 3
execute if score gametype variables matches 2 unless score minigameplayer variables matches 1.. run scoreboard players set minigameplayer variables 1
execute as @a[scores={minigameplayer=1..}] if score @s minigameplayer = minigameplayer variables at @e[tag=center] run function mcp:player_circle_place_player
scoreboard players operation rotationChange variables = 360 constants
scoreboard players operation rotationChange variables /= playersInCircle variables
execute as @e[tag=center,limit=1] run function mcp:rotate_entity
execute unless score minigameplayer variables >= playersInCircle variables run function mcp:player_circle
kill @e[tag=center]
scoreboard players reset radius variables
scoreboard players reset rotationChange variables
scoreboard players reset rotation variables
scoreboard players reset playersInCircle variables
scoreboard players reset minigameplayer variables
functions.player_circle_place_player:
execute unless entity @e[tag=playerPosition] run summon minecraft:marker ~ ~ ~ {Tags:["playerPosition"]}
scoreboard players add playerRadius variables 1
execute as @e[tag=playerPosition] at @s rotated as @e[tag=center] run tp @s ^ ^ ^1
execute if score playerRadius variables < radius variables run function mcp:player_circle_place_player
execute unless score playerRadius variables < radius variables at @e[tag=playerPosition,limit=1] run tp @s ~ ~ ~ facing entity @e[tag=center,limit=1]
execute unless score playerRadius variables < radius variables run kill @e[tag=playerPosition]
execute unless score playerRadius variables < radius variables run scoreboard players reset playerRadius variables
functions.rotate_entity:
# rotationChange variables must be set and reset outside of this function. rotation variables needs to be reset outside of this function
execute if score rotationChange variables matches 0 run scoreboard players set rotationChange variables 36
execute store result score rotation variables run data get entity @s Rotation[0]
scoreboard players operation rotation variables += rotationChange variables
execute store result storage mcp:variables rotation float 1 run scoreboard players get rotation variables
data modify entity @s Rotation[0] set from storage mcp:variables rotation
